title: Player registration is open
text: Under-16 boys can register free for Season 1 and enter the player auction pool.

title: Free entry for spectators
text: No tickets needed. Registration is free for players, and entry is free for everyone watching.

title: Sixteen franchise slots open for enquiry
text: Franchise enquiries for Season 1 are now being accepted.

title: Player auction date to be announced
text: Registered players will hear first, by email.
